title.zh: 新加坡国内税务局（职能转授）公告 2013
title.en: Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore (Assignment of Function) Notification 2013

completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 1 条。

text.en:
Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore Act
(CHAPTER 138A)
Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore
(Assignment of Function)
Notification 2013
In exercise of the powers conferred by section 6(2) of the Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore Act, the Minister for Finance hereby assigns to the Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore the function of administering the wage credit scheme introduced by the Government in 2013.
